seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation. Reproducibility is not guaranteed.

image.title: Image
image.description: First-frame image for image-to-video or first/last-frame generation. Cannot be combined with reference images, videos, or audios.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for video generation. Optional when a media input (image, reference images/videos/audios) is supplied. Seedance 2.5 works best with detailed, structured 'production brief' style prompts.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Video duration in seconds. Set to -1 for intelligent duration (the model picks the best length). Editing mode requires -1.

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.description: Add a watermark to the generated video.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio. Set to 'adaptive' to let the model choose the best ratio based on inputs. First/last-frame, editing, and extension modes require 'adaptive'.

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Generate synchronized audio with the video, including dialogue (use double quotes in prompt), sound effects, and background music.

last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_image.description: Last-frame image. Requires a first-frame image. Cannot be combined with reference images, videos, or audios.

reference_audios.title: Reference Audios
reference_audios.description: Reference audio files (up to 10, combined duration max 30s) for audio-driven generation and lip-sync. Requires at least one reference image or video. Reference them in your prompt as [Audio1], [Audio2], etc.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Reference images (up to 30) for character consistency, style guidance, and scene composition. Cannot be combined with first/last frame images. Reference them in your prompt as [Image1], [Image2], etc.

reference_videos.title: Reference Videos
reference_videos.description: Reference videos (up to 10, combined duration max 30s) for motion transfer, style reference, editing, and extension. Reference them in your prompt as [Video1], [Video2], etc.

fps.title: fps
fps.description: Frame rate in frames per second

image.title: Image
image.description: First frame image for image-to-video generation

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video to generate

duration.title: duration
duration.description: Duration of the video in seconds. Durations longer than 10 seconds are only available at 720p or 1080p resolution with 24 or 25 FPS. 48/50 FPS caps at 10 seconds.

resolution.title: resolution
resolution.description: Resolution quality of the generated video. Higher resolutions cap the maximum duration.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video

generate_audio.title: Generate Audio
generate_audio.description: Generate audio for the video. Used for text_to_video and image_to_video tasks.

last_frame_image.title: Last Frame Image
last_frame_image.description: Last frame image for image-to-video generation. When provided, the video interpolates between the first frame and this last frame.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible generation. Range: 0-2147483647

image.title: Image
image.description: Optional reference image for image editing, style transfer, or image-to-image generation

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation or editing

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to specify elements to avoid in the generated image

match_input_image.title: Match Input Image
match_input_image.description: When true and an image is provided, use the input image's aspect ratio and resolution instead of the aspect_ratio parameter

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Automatically expand and optimize the prompt for better results

size.title: size
size.description: Image resolution. Standard mode supports 1K and 2K. Layer decomposition mode supports 1K, 1.5K, 2K, and auto; auto sizes the base image and layers from the input image.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt. In standard mode, describes the image to generate. In layer decomposition mode it is optional: describe which elements to split out, or leave blank to auto-detect all major elements. Maximum 4000 characters.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: Input image(s). In standard mode, 1-10 reference images for image-to-image generation. In layer decomposition mode, exactly one image to decompose.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Image aspect ratio (ignored in layer decomposition mode). Use 'match_input_image' to automatically match the input image's aspect ratio.

output_format.title: output_format
output_format.description: Output image format. In layer decomposition mode this only controls the base image; layers are always returned as PNG.

layer_decomposition.title: Layer Decomposition
layer_decomposition.description: Split a single input image into a base image plus separate element layers (up to 16). Requires exactly one input image. Each returned layer includes its stacking order, bounding box, name, and description.

size.title: size
size.description: Width and height of the generated image. Size is ignored if an aspect ratio is set.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation (up to 10,000 characters)

style_id.title: Style Id
style_id.description: Reusable Recraft style ID created with the Create style endpoint. Mutually exclusive with style_reference_images.

style_match.title: style_match
style_match.description: How closely the generated image should follow the style.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

style_reference_images.title: Style Reference Images
style_reference_images.description: PNG, JPG, or WEBP reference images used to create a private style for this generation. Supports 1-10 images. Mutually exclusive with style_id.

size.title: size
size.description: Width and height of the generated image. Size is ignored if an aspect ratio is set.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Text prompt for image generation (up to 10,000 characters)

style_id.title: Style Id
style_id.description: Reusable Recraft style ID created with the Create style endpoint. Mutually exclusive with style_reference_images.

style_match.title: style_match
style_match.description: How closely the generated image should follow the style.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

style_reference_images.title: Style Reference Images
style_reference_images.description: PNG, JPG, or WEBP reference images used to create a private style for this generation. Supports 1-10 images. Mutually exclusive with style_id.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: Public URL of the source audio or video file to dub (e.g. a direct link, YouTube, or TikTok URL). Provide this or audio_or_video_file.

source_language.title: source_language
source_language.description: Language of the source media, as a BCP-47 tag. Leave as 'auto' to detect it automatically.

target_language.title: target_language
target_language.description: Language to dub the content into, as a BCP-47 tag. Some languages also offer region-qualified dialects (e.g. 'es-MX', 'pt-BR', 'en-GB').

cloning_strength.title: Cloning Strength
cloning_strength.description: How strongly the dubbed speakers clone the source voices, from 0 to 10. Higher values prioritize resemblance to the original voice; lower values give the model more freedom for natural delivery in the target language. The default of 7 works well for most content.

audio_or_video_file.title: Audio Or Video File
audio_or_video_file.description: Audio or video file to dub. Provide this or source_url.
